query: What's the best laptop for a college student on a budget under $1,000?
atoms: build quality and durability over 4 years
performance for coursework and light creative tasks
resale value at end of college
value for price at lower budget tiers
plausible_answers: Answer A (Lenovo IdeaPad Default): Get the Lenovo IdeaPad Flex 5 or Acer Aspire 5 in the $500–700 range — they offer adequate performance, good battery life, and strong value for standard college coursework without stretching the budget.

Answer B (Refurbished MacBook Air): Stretch to a refurbished M1 MacBook Air at $800–900 — the unmatched battery life, build quality, and 5+ year longevity make it the best total cost of ownership under $1,000.

Answer C (ThinkPad for Durability): Choose a Lenovo ThinkPad E-series — business-grade durability, excellent keyboard, and strong repairability make it the best laptop to actually survive 4 years of college without degradation.
baseline_answer: Answer B (Refurbished MacBook Air): Stretch to a refurbished M1 MacBook Air at $800–900 — the unmatched battery life, build quality, and 5+ year longevity make it the best total cost of ownership under $1,000.
